notes.title: 雷鸟Thunderbird Demo small patch
notes.content:
Game content adjustments:
Type-a and Type-B will have two different sound effects when hit
Added selection sound when first entering the game selection language
Added selection sound when selecting difficulty
During the game, the HI score display at the top of the screen is adjusted to display the highest score of the corresponding mode of the corresponding body
Changed to do not shoot when some enemy positions are at the bottom of the panel
Horizontal movement speed of red mainframes has been increased
BUG fix:
Fixed an issue where leaderboards could not continue counting when they exceeded 10
Fixed an issue where gold nuggets could not be retrieved by rotating around the machine
Fixed bug Mc-117516 - Select body interface button, click to determine inaccurate
Fixed a tank factory where tanks could be destroyed by partitions before leaving the house
Fixed a problem where helicopters on the apron would be tracked by tracking bullets when not taking off without judgment
Fixed an issue where the first wave of enemies would shake
Fixed some map mismatch hierarchy errors
